# Dynex Capital, Inc. Named One of TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders for 2027


October 26, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://www.dynexcapital.com/_assets/_988e42b1c4f9b0ca9770a65a9f06c6ea/dynexcapital/news/2026-10-26_Dynex_Capital_Inc_Named_One_of_TIME_s_America_s_431.pdf)


GLEN ALLEN, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Dynex Capital, Inc. (NYSE: DX, “Dynex” or the “Company”) is proud to announce its inclusion in the America’s Growth Leaders 2027 list, a distinguished ranking honoring companies demonstrating exceptional growth performance, financial stability, and stock performance. This recognition is presented by TIME and Statista, global leaders in data analysis and industry benchmarking, and it can now be viewed on time.com.


Being named to the America’s Growth Leaders 2027 list signifies that Dynex stands among the most accomplished businesses in the United States. These organizations have consistently excelled in expanding their market presence, maintaining strong financial foundations, and delivering value to shareholders. Inclusion in this elite group reflects sustained success, resilience through market fluctuations, and the ability to create lasting impact in the competitive global landscape.


“Since 2022, we have grown Dynex fivefold while delivering nearly 50% total shareholder return,” said Smriti Laxman Popenoe, Co-Chief Executive Officer and President of Dynex. “That growth reflects the strength of the platform we have built and the disciplined approach we have taken to scaling the company. We remain grounded in disciplined risk management, capital flexibility and a long-term approach to investing. As we continue to scale, we believe those same principles position us to navigate market cycles, capitalize on opportunities and create long-term value for our shareholders.”


**About Dynex Capital**


Dynex Capital, Inc. (NYSE: DX) is a leading internally managed REIT with a long track record of delivering attractive dividends through the disciplined risk management of investments in high‑quality mortgage assets backed by U.S. residential and commercial real estate. For more information on Dynex, please visit our website at[www.dynexcapital.com](http://www.dynexcapital.com/) or connect with us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dynex-capital-inc) .


**About Statista**


Statista publishes hundreds of worldwide industry rankings and company listings with high-profile media partners. This research and analysis service is based on the success of statista.com, the leading data and business intelligence portal that provides statistics, relevant business data, and various market and consumer studies and surveys.
